pr_title: Hide the mouse when the user is typing in the editor
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4461

This PR improves the coding experience by hiding the mouse while the user is typing so it does not accidentally get in their way, making it challenging to ready characters in the editor.

Release Notes:

- The following PR hides the cursor when the user is typing by adding a new cursor style called `None`.
- Assuming the user does not move the mouse, it will stay hidden until it is moved again.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6ba9f2ee-b9f3-4595-81e4-e9d986da4a39

issue_context.title: Hide Mouse Cursor While Typing
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [X] Completed

### Describe the feature

Sometimes the mouse cursor obscures the text I am editing. Some other IDEs will temporarily hide the mouse cursor when you begin typing & I think it would be nice to have in Zed!

### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature


Xcode is a good example of this feature

https://github.com/zed-industries/community/assets/17223924/938d7223-8c7a-4966-af26-c04e07828af4
comments: Is this planned? Constantly moving the cursor out of the way is not a great experience.

This is definitely one of those rough edges that leaves a mark. Having moved from VSCode, it took me ages to figure out that when you start typing, the mouse cursor is hidden until you move it. It's just The Right Thing To Do - I've placed the cursor there, now get the hell out of the way so I can see what I'm doing.

I submitted PR for this issue.
But I have only macOS device.

Can someone implement this feature for Windows and Linux ?

This is still unresolved (at least for macOS). 

Also couldn't find a setting to enable this behaviour, though it should definitely be the expected standard.

Any updates from ZED industries?
Since I cannot bear it not to have the cursor hidden when typing, i had to go out in the wilds and catch an app that hides it after a few seconds (cursorcerer). not perfect but at least something.
https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25040 is close, but got reverted due to macOS issues for certain users: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25393

review_comments: If this variant should be impossible, instead of panic'ing in here, maybe you should replace `CursorStyle::None` by `Option<CursorStyle>`, or a new enum that has `CursorStyle` as a variant of it.

This is meant to match the `cursor` CSS property, which has a `none` value. We could make it `Option` but I think that's less nice at the GPUI API level. To me, having this unreachable case here doesn't justify it. Having to handle it in the client is also specific to the Linux platform.
hey @tmickleydoyle why do we need to create an invisible cursor?

@marcospb19 I didn't find a better way to hide the cursor in X11. I saw someone suggest to move it to place outside the screen but that seemed really hacky. Let me know if you know of a better way to do it.
Oh, there's also `XFixesHideCursor` but that requires the XFIXES extension
Same here, if this branch is undesired, there must be a way to avoid it.
